<!--
    Read plans/README.md first. Most of what people ask for is already planned,
    with a cost estimate and a place in the queue. If your idea is in there, a
    link to the section is a much more useful issue than a new one.
-->

## The problem

<!-- Not the solution. "The accounts list times out at 10 000 accounts", not
     "add caching". A problem statement is checkable; a solution is a guess. -->

## Who has this problem

<!-- A store with 3 products and a store with 300 000 need different things. -->

## What you have tried

<!-- Including a workaround you are willing to keep using. That changes the
     priority more than the feature description does. -->

## Proposal

<!-- Optional. If you have already written it down, it saves a round trip. -->

## Alternatives

<!-- What you would do if this were never built. "I would export to CSV by hand"
     is a real answer. -->

## Scope check

<!-- Answer honestly; it helps more than it costs. -->

- [ ] This is a capability, not a bug report
- [ ] I checked `plans/` and this is not already planned
- [ ] It does not require changing the public hook contract
- [ ] I understand this is a one-maintainer project and a request is not a commitment

## Willing to implement it

- [ ] I can open a pull request for this
- [ ] Not now, but I can review one
- [ ] No, reporting is the extent of my involvement
